title: Fix Framework Os Dev Cad Command
description: bun ./📜️script.ts dev cad failed because spawnBunx/runBunx executed bun x vite in unicode ZWJ cwd (🧰️framework/🛍️product/💻️os/🔨️module/🧑️‍💻️dev/⚡️implementation/🟦️typescript), triggering Bun's internal CouldntReadCurrentDirectory error, and jco transpile failed under Bun due to unimplemented tcp_wrap in worker_threads.
summary: Updated resolveWorkspaceBin to support scoped packages and resolve workspace/local node_modules/.bin executables directly in runBunx, spawnBunx, and runCmdInternal. Added runNodeBinStatus to execute jco under Node.js runtime (which implements process.binding('tcp_wrap')). Updated runWasmPackWebBuild to invoke local/system wasm-pack directly rather than via bun x. Updated devToolingEnv to default RUSTC_WRAPPER to empty string when sccache IPC sockets are unavailable. Verified successful compilation and jco transpilation of cad component.
